initialization: Same locally verified generic pretrained checkpoint; replace the final class head identically per seed; no automatic download
budget_matching: Match initialization, model seeds, optimizer-update count, batch size and validation protocol; record real/synthetic sampling counts
independence_limitations: Whole trajectories define splits. Nearby frames are dependent and repeated development selection is disclosed. Report undefined foreground metrics explicitly.
improvement_claim: Requires completed matched multi-seed experiments and qualified real references; configuration or smoke checks do not demonstrate improvement
hypothesis: Reduce pretrained-feature drift on the small training cohort without changing references, loss, input resolution, seeds or optimizer-update budget.
selection_policy: One corrective configuration frozen before execution; report all configured seeds and both positive and negative outcomes. No held-out evaluation or synthetic parameter fitting.
